description: Werkingsgebied - Herstructureringsgebied windturbines binnen de MRA is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.noord-holland.nl. This scope is part of the NH2020 Environment Regulation, adopted on 16-11-2020 (Decision No: 1477251/1478383). The plan can be consulted on Spatial Plans.nl via this link: More information about this scope can be found in article(s): 6.27. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Scope — Restructuring area of wind turbines within the MRA" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ruimtelijke ordening. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
